name: sweep
description: Keep a folder organized, and find leftover sysadmin artifacts (.bak, .orig, dated config copies...): sort, surface, quarantine the stale ones, never delete.

folder.about: the folder to keep tidy, e.g. ~/Downloads

threshold.about: wake when more than this many loose files pile up

artifact_paths.about: where to look for leftover backups and editor droppings (space-separated)

stale_days.about: an artifact older than this, whose original has moved on, counts as stale
